observations.formatting_gate: pnpm format:check exits 1 over 25 files and is reported red. The Owner's directive §1 authorized exactly one .prettierignore correction (the H-13 hole, applied and verified) and forbade broad reformatting, so the red cannot be silenced from here. A second, measured reason: prettier --write over the tree rewrites bytes in files that docs/ cites by line number, converting a formatting fix into citation-gate defects. OID-25 holds the decision — accept the standing red, defer it, or schedule a dedicated reformatting batch with its own citation-repair pass.
observations.eval_guard_repair: Running the lint gate found that an inert security guard had been believed to work: tseslint.configs.strict disables the base no-eval, and the project's no-restricted-syntax selector matched only a string literal containing the word eval, so eval("1+1") passed lint at exit 0. no-eval, no-implied-eval and no-new-func are now enabled explicitly and a call-form selector was added. Measured after the repair: probes exit 1 with 8 named errors over the clean-tree baseline of 0, and no-eval reports severity 2 for both a src/ and a scripts/ file. The config file itself carries 3 self-matching no-restricted-syntax errors under a file-scoped, rule-scoped disable explained in its header.
observations.wildcard_bind: The runtime evidence recorded a socket-level truth: the start script is next start with no -H option, so netstat shows TCP 0.0.0.0:3122 LISTENING and the page answered on a LAN address with HTTP 200. The loopback-only guarantee belongs to the docker-compose publish, not to this command. Hardening start is an Owner decision, registered in docs/SECURITY_AND_PERMISSIONS.md §16.3 and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6 rather than silently fixed.
observations.honest_transcript: The transcript retains two harness lines that exited 2 because a grep pattern was passed unquoted, and prints the corrected block after them instead of editing the flawed lines out.
observations.stale_register_text: docs/ASSET_INVENTORY_AUDIT.csv carries the Actual Usage value "None — no application code exists yet (src/ is empty)" on 82 of 82 data rows (83 lines including the header). The value is still true — measured: 0 occurrences of next/image, 0 img elements and 0 asset file references anywhere under src/, and the only occurrence of the string Noujoude.photo under src/ is the read-only rule sentence in src/README.md — but the parenthetical is stale wording, because src/ now holds 32 files.
